newsitem.title: UK: VLCC Soro's steering system damaged off Scotland.
newsitem.headline: VLCC Soro's steering system damaged off Scotland.

text.p: The very large crude carrier (VLCC) Soro, laden with 283,793 tonnes of Norwegian crude bound for Canada, was hit by a freak wave off Scotland, damaging its steering system, the vessel's agents said on Wednesday.
A tug is being sent from Stornaway and the 299,718 dwt, Panamanian-flagged ship will be inspected and repaired, Marine Navigation Company said in a statement.
The wind was force 11-12 when the incident occurred on March 2, 28 nautical miles from land. There was no danger of oil leaking from the vessel, a company official said.
